body: Evidence round 1 addressed at bb954d30 — both reviewers reported the dogfooding link dead, and both were wrong about the tree (docs/artifacts/2026-07-decision-integrity-dogfooding.md is on main since #8801, blob 3c0458f1) but right about the landmine: the repo's 'artifacts/' gitignore rule shadowed the tracked file from every ignore-respecting tool, including reviewer grounding. Fixed at the root with a '!docs/artifacts/' negation so committed proof artifacts are visible to grep harnesses, doc-link validators, and reviewers alike.

Evidence round 2 addressed at 75893e9d: **[P2 openai]** demo one-liner now forces `--offline` (with keys present the real-demo path doesn't write aragora-demo-receipt.json — correct catch; the Try-it-now section already used the flag). **[P2 claude — dead link]** repeated claim, disproven at the branch tree with machine evidence: `git ls-tree HEAD -- docs/artifacts/` → blob 3c0458f1 present; `rg --files docs/artifacts/` now lists the file (negation effective); `git check-ignore` → not ignored; the file merged to main in #8801. Belt-and-braces `!docs/artifacts/**` child negation added. If the dead-link claim recurs against this evidence, it parks as demonstrated-false-positive dissent for operator adjudication.

Evidence round 3 disposition at 7e182074: both reviewers repeated the dead-link claim against the machine proof in this thread — openai's own wording ('this PR's complete changed-file list') reveals the mechanism: reviewer grounding reasons over the diff only and cannot see the base tree where the file has existed since #8801. Filed as #8825 (reviewer grounding blind spot). The link itself is now an absolute URL to main — objectively better for this README's off-GitHub renderings (PyPI long-description, mirrors) where relative links break, and verifiable without tree access. One final gate follows; if the claim survives an absolute URL, this parks for operator adjudication with the full three-round false-positive record.
